item.hotbath.peony_bath_bucket.desc: Gift from the king of flowers. Immerse yourself in floral paradise.

item.hotbath.splash_hot_water_bottle.des: Portable sauna grenade. The sudden heat makes everyone run faster. Apply directly to the forehead.
item.hotbath.splash_honey_bath_bottle.de: Tactical adhesive deployment. Grants a sticky shield of absorption. Sweet, but incredibly annoying to wash off.

hotbath.compat.not_installed.cold_sweat: $(7)Cold Sweat$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod to unlock temperature management features:$(br)$(li)Bath fluids maintain body temperature at ~37°C$(li)Bottles increase body temperature$(li)Perfect for surviving cold biomes!
hotbath.compat.not_installed.tough_as_na: $(7)Tough As Nails$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod to unlock:$(br)$(li)Warming effects when bathing$(li)Thirst restoration by drinking bath water$(li)Temperature regulation for survival
hotbath.compat.not_installed.lso: $(7)Legendary Survival Overhaul$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod for the most comprehensive integration:$(br)$(li)Advanced temperature management$(li)Cold Resistance accumulation$(li)Thirst restoration and Hot Drink effect
hotbath.compat.not_installed.alexs_mobs: $(7)Alex's Mobs$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod for animal interactions:$(br)$(li)Raccoons wash items faster in hot baths$(li)Capuchin monkeys enjoy hot springs$(li)Dirtiness attracts bugs
hotbath.compat.not_installed.alexs_caves: $(7)Alex's Caves$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod for cave creature interactions:$(br)$(li)Gummy Bears melt in hot water$(li)Herbal bath cures radiation$(li)Gammaroach and Raycat behaviors
hotbath.compat.not_installed.farmers_del: $(7)Farmer's Delight$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod to unlock:$(br)$(li)Nourishment effect while bathing$(li)Farmer's Delight recovery support
hotbath.compat.not_installed.twilight_fo: $(7)Twilight Forest$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod for dimension features:$(br)$(li)Remove Frosted effect with hot baths$(li)Firefly particles in the Twilight dimension
hotbath.compat.not_installed.serene_seas: $(7)Serene Seasons$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod for seasonal bonuses:$(br)$(li)Winter bathing grants Resistance$(li)Mid-winter bonus Regeneration$(li)Melt nearby ice and snow
hotbath.compat.not_installed.create: $(7)Create$() is not installed.$(br2)Install Create to use bath fluids with tanks, pipes, mixers, spouts, and item drains.
hotbath.compat.not_installed.epic_fight: $(7)Epic Fight$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod for combat animation compatibility:$(br)$(li)Dirt overlay renders on Epic Fight's animated player model$(li)Both first-person and third-person views supported$(li)Seamless integration with battle animations
hotbath.entry.epic_fight.name: Epic Fight
hotbath.entry.epic_fight.page1: $(l)Epic Fight$() replaces the vanilla player renderer with its own animated model during combat. $(thing)Hot Bath$() integrates with Epic Fight's rendering system to ensure the $(thing)dirtiness overlay$() displays correctly on the animated model.$(br2)This integration is $(2)automatic$() - no configuration needed!
hotbath.entry.epic_fight.rendering.title: How It Works
hotbath.entry.epic_fight.rendering: The dirtiness overlay is rendered as a $(thing)patched layer$() on Epic Fight's player renderer.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Third-person:$() Dirt appears on the animated combat model$(li)$(thing)First-person:$() Dirt shows on your arms during combat$(br2)The same dirt patterns, intensities, and body-part distribution apply as with the vanilla renderer.
hotbath.compat.not_installed.shower_core: $(7)Shower Core$() is not installed.$(br2)Install this mod to expand your bathing experience with:$(br)$(li)$(thing)Bathtubs$() - Stylish tubs in 33 variants$(li)$(thing)Shower Heads$() - Compact & Rain styles$(li)$(thing)Rubber Ducks$() - Cute floating companions!$(br2)Perfect companion mod for Hot Bath!
hotbath.entry.shower_core.name: ✨ Shower Core (Recommended)
hotbath.entry.shower_core.bathtub.title: Bathtubs
hotbath.entry.shower_core.bathtub: $(l)Shower Core$() adds beautiful $(thing)bathtubs$() in 33 different styles!$(br2)$(li)Wood variants: Oak, Birch, Spruce, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Crimson, Warped, Bamboo$(li)Stone variants: Stone, Cobblestone$(li)Metal variants: Iron, Gold, Copper, Diamond$(li)Colored variants: All 16 dye colors$(br2)Bathtubs work perfectly with Hot Bath fluids!
hotbath.entry.shower_core.shower.title: Shower Heads
hotbath.entry.shower_core.shower: Two types of shower heads available:$(br2)$(thing)Compact Shower Head$() - Classic handheld style$(br)$(thing)Rain Shower Head$() - Luxurious overhead rainfall$(br2)Both come in the same 33 style variants as bathtubs. Mount them on walls and enjoy a refreshing shower!
hotbath.entry.shower_core.duck.title: Rubber Ducks 🦆
hotbath.entry.shower_core.duck: The cutest addition to your bath!$(br2)$(li)Place on water, ground, or bathtubs$(li)Push them around with right-click$(li)They float and bob realistically$(li)Pick up with Shift + Right-click$(br2)No bath is complete without a rubber duck friend!
hotbath.book.name: Balneum Manuale
hotbath.book.subtitle: 1st Edition
hotbath.book.landing_text: Welcome to the Balneum Manuale! Take a break from your adventures and soak in a relaxing hot bath. This book covers everything from basic fluids to advanced custom fluid systems.

hotbath.entry.adv_hot_bath.name: Hot Bath
hotbath.entry.adv_hot_bath.page1: $(l)Hot Bath$() - "Start your day with a hot bath"$(br2)$(thing)Trigger:$() Obtain a Hot Water Bucket$(br)$(thing)Reward:$() 10 XP + All bath recipes unlocked$(br2)This is your first advancement! Simply craft or smelt a water bucket to get hot water and you'll unlock all the special bath recipes.
hotbath.entry.adv_challenges.name: Bath Challenges
hotbath.entry.adv_challenges.page1: These $(thing)Challenge$() advancements require dedication and repeated bathing. Each one tracks your cumulative soaks in a specific bath type!
hotbath.entry.adv_challenges.foot.title: Foot Health
hotbath.entry.adv_challenges.foot: "Daily wellness starts with a foot soak"$(br2)$(thing)Requirement:$() Soak in Hot Water $(thing)100 times$()$(br)$(thing)Reward:$() 100 XP$(br2)The ancient art of foot bathing. Keep those feet healthy!
hotbath.entry.adv_challenges.milk.title: Milk Skin
hotbath.entry.adv_challenges.milk: "Develop a habit of milk baths for fair and beautiful skin"$(br2)$(thing)Requirement:$() Soak in Milk Bath $(thing)100 times$()$(br)$(thing)Reward:$() 100 XP$(br2)Legend says Cleopatra bathed in milk daily!
hotbath.entry.adv_challenges.chronic: "Those with weak health should soak more"$(br2)$(thing)Requirement:$() Soak in Herbal Bath $(thing)100 times$()$(br)$(thing)Reward:$() 100 XP$(br2)Traditional medicine at its finest!
hotbath.entry.adv_challenges.rose.title: Rose Body Fragrance
hotbath.entry.adv_challenges.rose: "Only through long immersion and cultivation can you achieve true body fragrance"$(br2)$(thing)Requirement:$() Soak in Rose Bath $(thing)100 times$()$(br)$(thing)Reward:$() 100 XP$(br2)Become irresistible with natural rose scent!
hotbath.entry.adv_hidden.name: Hidden Achievements
hotbath.entry.adv_hidden.page1: Some advancements are $(thing)hidden$() - they won't appear until you discover them on your own!$(br2)$(8)Keep exploring and see what happens...$()
hotbath.entry.introduction.name: Introduction
hotbath.entry.introduction.page1: Welcome to $(l:hotbath:basics/introduction)Hot Bath$(/l)! This mod adds relaxing and therapeutic bath fluids to Minecraft. Each bath type provides unique buffs and healing effects when you soak in them.$(br2)Whether you need to recover health, remove negative effects, or just warm up, we have the perfect bath for you!
hotbath.entry.introduction.page2.title: Basic Mechanics
hotbath.entry.introduction.page2: $(li)Bathing for 15 seconds triggers special effects$(li)Different fluids provide different buffs$(li)Fluids restore health over time$(li)Soul Sand creates upward bubbles$(li)Magma Blocks create downward bubbles$(li)Custom particles match fluid colors
hotbath.entry.introduction.page3.title: Getting Started
hotbath.entry.introduction.page3: $(li)Start by smelting a $(item)Water Bucket$() in a furnace to get $(item)Hot Water$()$(li)Build a pool using any non-flammable blocks$(li)Pour your hot water and hop in!$(li)Upgrade to special baths by crafting with ingredients$(li)Check the $(l:hotbath:fluids/hot_water)Fluids$(/l) category for all bath types
hotbath.entry.bath_herb.name: Bath Herb
hotbath.entry.bath_herb.page1: $(item)Bath Herb$() is a mysterious ingredient from the Far East, essential for creating the Herbal Bath. These ancient herbs pulse with healing energy.
hotbath.entry.bath_herb.obtain.title: How to Obtain
hotbath.entry.bath_herb.obtain: $(li)Buy from $(thing)Novice Farmer Villagers$() for 10 emeralds$(li)Buy from $(thing)Wandering Traders$() for 15 emeralds$(br2)Stock up when you find them!
hotbath.entry.tips.name: Tips & Notes
hotbath.entry.tips.page1: When using bath fluids, please note:$(br)$(li)$(thing)Aquatic Life$(): Aquatic creatures won't spawn naturally in bath fluids, and fish (except tropical fish) and squids take damage in bath fluids.$(li)$(thing)Placement Restrictions$(): Surface plants, lily pads, seagrass, and turtle eggs cannot be placed in bath fluids. Coral plants will become dead coral shortly after being placed.$(li)$(thing)Fishing$(): Fishing in bath fluids will not catch anything.
hotbath.entry.tips.interactions.title: Fluid Interactions
hotbath.entry.tips.interactions: $(li)$(thing)Bubble Columns$(): Soul Sand creates upward bubbles, Magma Blocks create downward bubbles$(li)$(thing)Custom Particles$(): Bubbles and drip particles match the fluid color
hotbath.entry.hot_water.name: Hot Water
hotbath.entry.hot_water.page1: $(item)Hot Water$() is the foundation of all bath fluids. Simple yet effective, it washes away fatigue and provides a speed boost.
hotbath.entry.hot_water.recipe: Smelt a water bucket in any furnace to create hot water.
hotbath.entry.hot_water.effects.title: Effects
hotbath.entry.hot_water.effects: $(li)Bathing for 15s grants $(thing)Speed I$() (20s)$(br)$(li)$(thing)Hidden Achievement$(): [Foot Health] - Bathe 100 times for 100 XP
hotbath.entry.milk_bath.name: Milk Bath
hotbath.entry.milk_bath.page1: $(item)Milk Bath$() - The legendary beauty treatment! This creamy bath removes negative effects and restores both health and hunger.
hotbath.entry.milk_bath.recipe: Combine hot water with a milk bucket.
hotbath.entry.milk_bath.effects.title: Effects
hotbath.entry.milk_bath.effects: $(li)Restores $(thing)Health$() (0.25/2s)$(br)$(li)Restores $(thing)Hunger$() (1/15s)$(br)$(li)Bathing 15s removes all negative effects (except Bad Luck)$(br)$(li)$(thing)Hidden Achievement$(): [Milk Skin] - Bathe 100 times for 100 XP
hotbath.entry.herbal_bath.name: Herbal Bath
hotbath.entry.herbal_bath.page1: $(item)Herbal Bath$() - Ancient wisdom in liquid form! This therapeutic bath provides resistance and damages undead creatures.
hotbath.entry.herbal_bath.recipe: Combine hot water with 2 Bath Herbs.
hotbath.entry.herbal_bath.effects.title: Effects
hotbath.entry.herbal_bath.effects: $(li)Restores $(thing)Health$() (0.25/2s)$(br)$(li)Bathing 15s removes $(thing)ALL$() negative effects$(br)$(li)Bathing 5s grants $(thing)Resistance I$() (10s)$(br)$(li)Damages Undead mobs (0.5/s)$(br)$(li)$(thing)Hidden Achievement$(): [Chronic Invalid] - Bathe 100 times for 100 XP
hotbath.entry.honey_bath.name: Honey Bath
hotbath.entry.honey_bath.page1: $(item)Honey Bath$() - Cleopatra's beauty secret! This sticky bath provides absorption and restores hunger quickly, but slows you down.
hotbath.entry.honey_bath.recipe: Combine hot water with a honeycomb block.
hotbath.entry.honey_bath.effects.title: Effects
hotbath.entry.honey_bath.effects: $(li)Restores $(thing)Health$() (0.25/s) and $(thing)Hunger$() (1/4s)$(br)$(li)Gives $(thing)Slowness I$() while bathing$(br)$(li)Bathing 15s removes negative effects (except Slowness/Bad Luck)$(br)$(li)Bathing 15s grants $(thing)Absorption II$() (20s)
hotbath.entry.peony_bath.name: Peony Bath
hotbath.entry.peony_bath.page1: $(item)Peony Bath$() - Gift from the king of flowers! This elegant bath provides knockback resistance and eventually grants luck.
hotbath.entry.peony_bath.effects.title: Effects
hotbath.entry.peony_bath.effects: $(li)Restores $(thing)Health$() (0.25/2s)$(br)$(li)Bathing 15s removes negative effects and Bad Omen$(br)$(li)Bathing 15s grants $(thing)Knockback Resistance$() (+0.05, 30s)$(br)$(li)Bathing 15s grants $(thing)Attack Speed$() (+10%, 15s)$(br)$(li)$(thing)Special$(): After 50 baths, grants $(thing)Luck I$() (45s)
hotbath.entry.rose_bath.name: Rose Bath
hotbath.entry.rose_bath.page1: $(item)Rose Bath$() - A romantic treat! This fragrant bath provides strength and removes the Bad Omen effect.
hotbath.entry.rose_bath.recipe: Combine hot water with 8 rose bushes.
hotbath.entry.rose_bath.effects.title: Effects
hotbath.entry.rose_bath.effects: $(li)Restores $(thing)Health$() (0.25/s)$(br)$(li)Bathing 15s removes negative effects and Bad Omen$(br)$(li)Bathing 15s grants $(thing)Strength I$() (20s)$(br)$(li)$(thing)Hidden Achievement$(): [Rose Body Fragrance] - Bathe 100 times for 100 XP
hotbath.entry.drinkable_bottles.name: Drinkable Bottles
hotbath.entry.drinkable_bottles.page1: Bath water can be bottled for portable use! Right-click any bath fluid with a glass bottle to collect it. These bottles provide effects when consumed.
hotbath.entry.bottles.hot_water.title: Hot Water Bottle
hotbath.entry.bottles.hot_water: Bath water, but warm water is safe to drink... right?$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Grants $(thing)Speed I$() for 45 seconds.
hotbath.entry.bottles.honey.title: Honey Bath Bottle
hotbath.entry.bottles.honey: Smells like sweet honey... just one sip wouldn't hurt?$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Grants $(thing)Absorption I$() for 45 seconds.
hotbath.entry.bottles.milk.title: Milk Bath Bottle
hotbath.entry.bottles.milk: Has a subtle milky aroma. Bath water never looked so tempting...$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Randomly removes 1 negative effect.
hotbath.entry.bottles.herbal.title: Herbal Bath Bottle
hotbath.entry.bottles.herbal: Herbal fragrance fills the air. Medicine or refreshment? Why not both!$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Heals 3 hearts and grants $(thing)Resistance I$() for 45 seconds.
hotbath.entry.bottles.peony.title: Peony Bath Bottle
hotbath.entry.bottles.peony: Carries an elegant floral scent. Can bath water be this fragrant?$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Grants $(thing)Luck I$() for 45 seconds.
hotbath.entry.bottles.rose.title: Rose Bath Bottle
hotbath.entry.bottles.rose: Rich rose aroma is intoxicating. Irresistible urge to take a sip...$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Grants $(thing)Strength I$() for 45 seconds.
hotbath.entry.splash_bottles.name: Splash Bottles
hotbath.entry.splash_bottles.page1: Splash bottles can be thrown like potions! Brew any bath water bottle with gunpowder in a brewing stand to create splash versions.
hotbath.entry.splash.hot_water.title: Splash Hot Water
hotbath.entry.splash.hot_water: Portable sauna grenade. The sudden heat makes everyone run faster.$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Grants $(thing)Speed II$() for 30 seconds.
hotbath.entry.splash.honey.title: Splash Honey Bath
hotbath.entry.splash.honey: Tactical adhesive deployment. Grants a sticky shield of absorption.$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Grants $(thing)Absorption II$() for 30 seconds.
hotbath.entry.splash.milk.title: Splash Milk Bath
hotbath.entry.splash.milk: The ultimate debuff cleanser. Washes away your sins and status ailments.$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Removes 2 negative effects.
hotbath.entry.splash.herbal.title: Splash Herbal Bath
hotbath.entry.splash.herbal: A cocktail of ancient wisdom. Toughens the skin against damage.$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Grants $(thing)Resistance II$() for 30 seconds and heals 2 hearts.
hotbath.entry.splash.peony.title: Splash Peony Bath
hotbath.entry.splash.peony: A botanical airstrike. Bestows good fortune upon impact.$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Grants $(thing)Luck II$() for 30 seconds.
hotbath.entry.splash.rose.title: Splash Rose Bath
hotbath.entry.splash.rose: Liquid romance, delivered at high velocity. Grants the strength of a thousand thorns.$(br2)$(l)Effect$(): Grants $(thing)Strength II$() for 30 seconds.
hotbath.entry.cold_sweat.name: Cold Sweat
hotbath.entry.cold_sweat.page1: $(l)Cold Sweat$() provides the deepest temperature integration. Hot baths intelligently interact with the mod's temperature system.
hotbath.entry.cold_sweat.immersion.title: Bath Immersion
hotbath.entry.cold_sweat.immersion: $(li)While in a hot bath, your body temperature is maintained at a comfortable ~37°C$(li)The bath temperature is compared to the biome temperature - the higher value is used$(li)Custom fluids with temperature ≥35°C are considered 'hot'$(li)Perfect for surviving freezing biomes!
hotbath.entry.cold_sweat.bottles.title: Bottle Effects
hotbath.entry.cold_sweat.bottles: $(li)Drinking bath water bottles increases body temperature$(li)Splash bottles apply temperature effects in an area$(li)Both regular and splash bottles provide Cold Resistance II for 30 seconds
hotbath.entry.cold_sweat.custom.title: Custom Fluids
hotbath.entry.cold_sweat.custom: $(li)Custom fluids with $(thing)temperature ≥ 35°C$() work with Cold Sweat$(li)The fluid's temperature value is converted to Minecraft units$(li)Lower temperature custom fluids are ignored by the temperature system
hotbath.entry.tough_as_nails.name: Tough As Nails
hotbath.entry.tough_as_nails.page1: $(l)Tough As Nails$() integration provides temperature regulation and thirst management through hot baths.
hotbath.entry.tough_as_nails.temperature: $(li)While in any hot bath, your temperature level is set to $(thing)WARM$()$(li)After leaving the bath, the warming effect $(thing)lingers for 10 seconds$()$(li)Great for recovering from freezing!
hotbath.entry.tough_as_nails.thirst: $(li)Right-click with empty hand in bath to drink$(li)Hand drinking restores thirst$(li)Bath water bottles also restore thirst when consumed
hotbath.entry.tough_as_nails.bottles: $(li)Drinking bath bottles provides warming effect$(li)Splash bottles apply effects to nearby entities$(li)Both types provide Cold Resistance buff
hotbath.entry.lso.name: LSO
hotbath.entry.lso.page1: $(l)Legendary Survival Overhaul$() provides the most comprehensive integration with advanced temperature, thirst, and cold resistance mechanics.
hotbath.entry.lso.temperature.title: Temperature Warming
hotbath.entry.lso.temperature: $(li)Hot baths warm players toward the comfortable zone$(li)Prevents shivering and hypothermia$(li)Applied via LSO's modifier system$(li)Only hot baths (≥35°C) provide warming
hotbath.entry.lso.resistance.title: Cold Resistance
hotbath.entry.lso.resistance: $(li)After $(thing)10 seconds$() of bathing, you gain $(thing)Cold Resistance III$()$(li)Effect $(thing)accumulates$() with more bathing time$(li)Maximum duration: $(thing)5 minutes$()$(li)$(thing)Cold Immunity$() buff for 10s after leaving$(li)Prevents immediate re-freezing!
hotbath.entry.lso.thirst.title: Thirst & Bottles
hotbath.entry.lso.thirst: $(li)Drinking in bath restores $(thing)5 thirst$() + $(thing)0.5 saturation$()$(li)Bath bottles provide $(thing)Hot Drink$() effect (Level I)$(li)Drinking while bathing gives boosted $(thing)Hot Drink III$()$(li)Helps maintain body temperature!
hotbath.entry.other_compat.name: Other Integrations
hotbath.entry.other_compat.page1: Hot Bath integrates with many more mods! Check the detailed entries for each supported mod in this category.
hotbath.entry.other_compat.mods.title: Quick Reference
hotbath.entry.other_compat.mods: $(li)$(l)Alex's Mobs$(): Raccoons, monkeys, dirtiness$(li)$(l)Alex's Caves$(): Gummy bears, radiation cure$(li)$(l)Twilight Forest$(): Frosted removal, fireflies$(li)$(l)Farmer's Delight$(): Nourishment effect$(li)$(l)Serene Seasons$(): Winter resistance boost$(li)$(l)Create$(): fluid automation$(li)$(l)Epic Fight$(): dirtiness overlay on animated combat models
hotbath.entry.alexs_mobs.name: Alex's Mobs
hotbath.entry.alexs_mobs.page1: $(l)Alex's Mobs$() integration adds realistic animal behaviors and the $(thing)Dirtiness$() system for bug attraction.
hotbath.entry.alexs_mobs.raccoon.title: Raccoon Washing
hotbath.entry.alexs_mobs.raccoon: $(li)Raccoons wash items $(thing)1.5x faster$() in hot bath fluids$(li)When washing items in hot bath, raccoons have $(thing)1.5x higher tame chance$()$(li)They prefer warm water like real tanuki!
hotbath.entry.alexs_mobs.capuchin.title: Hot Spring Monkeys
hotbath.entry.alexs_mobs.capuchin: $(li)$(thing)Capuchin Monkeys$() are attracted to hot springs$(li)They will sit and soak like Japanese macaques!$(li)Monkeys in hot springs receive $(thing)Regeneration$() buff$(li)Easier to tame while relaxing in warm water
hotbath.entry.alexs_mobs.dirtiness.title: Dirtiness & Bugs
hotbath.entry.alexs_mobs.dirtiness: $(li)When extremely dirty, $(thing)Flies$() swarm around you$(li)$(thing)Crimson Mosquitoes$() become aggressive$(li)$(thing)Cockroaches$() loiter at 3-6 blocks distance$(li)Take a bath to become clean and bug-free!
hotbath.entry.alexs_caves.name: Alex's Caves
hotbath.entry.alexs_caves.page1: $(l)Alex's Caves$() integration includes candy melting, radiation curing, and cave creature interactions.
hotbath.entry.alexs_caves.gummy.title: Gummy Bear Melting
hotbath.entry.alexs_caves.gummy: $(li)$(thing)Gummy Bears$() melt in hot water!$(br)$(li)They take $(thing)0.5 damage per second$()$(br)$(li)They're made of candy after all...$(br)$(li)Keep your gummy friends away from baths!
hotbath.entry.alexs_caves.radiation: $(li)$(thing)Herbal Bath$() can cure the $(thing)IRRADIATED$() effect$(br)$(li)Reduces radiation level by 1 every $(thing)5 seconds$()$(br)$(li)If level was I, effect is fully removed$(br)$(li)The healing herbs neutralize radioactive particles!
hotbath.entry.alexs_caves.gammaroach: $(li)$(thing)Gammaroaches$() are attracted to dirty players$(br)$(li)At 80%%+ dirtiness, they approach cautiously$(br)$(li)With fly status (extreme dirt), they become $(thing)aggressive$()!$(br)$(li)Bath regularly to avoid nuclear cockroach attacks!
hotbath.entry.alexs_caves.raycat.title: Raycat Rest
hotbath.entry.alexs_caves.raycat: $(li)$(thing)Raycats$() enjoy sitting near hot springs$(br)$(li)Uses shared cat behavior system$(br)$(li)They find warm spots relaxing
hotbath.entry.farmers_delight.name: Farmer's Delight
hotbath.entry.farmers_delight.page1: $(l)Farmer's Delight$() integration provides the $(thing)Nourishment$() effect while bathing.
hotbath.entry.farmers_delight.comfort: $(li)While in any hot bath, you gain $(thing)Nourishment I$()$(li)Effect refreshes every 2 seconds$(li)Nourishment now covers Farmer's Delight's former Comfort role$(li)Perfect for relaxing after a hard day of farming
hotbath.entry.twilight_forest.name: Twilight Forest
hotbath.entry.twilight_forest.page1: $(l)Twilight Forest$() integration provides frost protection and atmospheric effects.
hotbath.entry.twilight_forest.frosted: $(li)Hot baths $(thing)remove the Frosted effect$()$(li)Checked every second while bathing$(li)No more being frozen by Aurora Palace!$(li)The warm water thaws you out instantly
hotbath.entry.twilight_forest.firefly: $(li)In the $(thing)Twilight Forest dimension$(), firefly particles spawn around bath pools$(li)Creates magical atmosphere$(li)Particles appear every 0.5 seconds$(li)Within 8 blocks of the bath
hotbath.entry.twilight_forest.ice_mobs: $(li)$(c)Ice creatures$() take damage in hot baths!$(li)Affected mobs: $(thing)Ice Crystal$(), $(thing)Stable/Unstable Ice Core$()$(li)$(thing)Snow Guardian$() and $(thing)Snow Queen$() boss$(li)1 damage every second$(li)The hot water melts them away!
hotbath.entry.serene_seasons.name: Serene Seasons
hotbath.entry.serene_seasons.page1: $(l)Serene Seasons$() integration provides seasonal bonuses and ice/snow melting.
hotbath.entry.serene_seasons.winter: $(li)During $(thing)Winter$(), bathing grants extra $(thing)Resistance$()$(li)$(thing)Early/Late Winter$(): Resistance I$(li)$(thing)Mid Winter$(): Resistance II + Regeneration I$(li)Effects last 10 seconds, refreshed every 2s$(li)Hot baths also melt nearby ice and snow!
hotbath.entry.create.name: Create
hotbath.entry.create.page1: $(l)Create$() integration lets Hot Bath fluids join Create's fluid automation.$(br2)Bath fluids can move through tanks, pumps, and pipes, and open pipe ends can apply bath effects.
hotbath.entry.create.automation.title: Automation
hotbath.entry.create.automation: $(li)Spouts fill bath bottles from matching fluids$(li)Item drains empty bath bottles back into fluids$(li)Heated mixers can make common bath fluids$(li)Data-pack custom bath fluids keep their own identity in Create fluid handling
hotbath.entry.custom_overview.name: Overview
hotbath.entry.custom_overview.page1: Hot Bath supports $(thing)data-driven custom fluids$()! You can create your own bath liquids with unique colors, effects, and properties using data packs.
hotbath.entry.custom_overview.features: $(li)Custom colors and visual effects$(li)Configurable potion effects$(li)Adjustable trigger time$(li)Temperature and viscosity settings$(li)Multi-language support$(li)Automatic bucket and bottle items$(li)Works with brewing stands
hotbath.entry.custom_structure.name: File Structure
hotbath.entry.custom_structure.page1: Custom fluids are defined in data packs. Place your JSON files in the correct folders for the game to recognize them.
hotbath.entry.custom_structure.datapack: Place fluid definitions in:$(br2)$(8)data/<namespace>/hotbath/custom_fluids/<name>.json$()$(br2)Example:$(br)$(8)data/mypack/hotbath/custom_fluids/golden_bath.json$()$(br2)$(Translation files (optional): For custom translations, add lang files to a resource pack. The fluid JSON can also include inline translations.
hotbath.entry.custom_json.name: JSON Format
hotbath.entry.custom_json.page1: Each custom fluid is defined by a JSON file with various properties. All fields except $(thing)id$() are optional and have sensible defaults.
hotbath.entry.custom_json.fields.title: Basic Fields
hotbath.entry.custom_json.fields: $(li)$(thing)id$(): Fluid identifier (required)$(li)$(thing)color$(): Integer color value (hex)$(li)$(thing)viscosity$(): Flow speed (default 1000)$(li)$(thing)density$(): Fluid weight (default 1000)$(li)$(thing)luminosity$(): Light level 0-15 (default 2)$(li)$(thing)opacity$(): Transparency 0.0-1.0 (default 1.0)$(li)$(thing)nutrition$(): Food value when drunk (default 0)
hotbath.entry.custom_json.visual.title: Visual Properties
hotbath.entry.custom_json.visual: $(li)$(thing)show_particles$(): Colored particles (default true)$(li)$(thing)show_bubbles$(): Bubble effects (default true)$(li)$(thing)show_steam$(): Steam on hot fluids (default true)$(li)$(thing)texture_still$(): Custom still texture$(li)$(thing)texture_flowing$(): Custom flowing texture$(br2)These let you create unique looking baths!
hotbath.entry.custom_json.temperature: $(li)$(thing)temperature$(): Celsius (default 40.0)$(li)$(thing)trigger_time_seconds$(): Effect delay (default 15)$(br2)$(c)Hot Threshold: 35°C$()$(br)$(li)≥35°C: Shows steam, integrates with temperature mods$(li)<35°C: Cold bath, no steam or temperature effects$(br2)Temperature affects mod integrations like Cold Sweat!
hotbath.entry.custom_json.effects.title: Effects Array
hotbath.entry.custom_json.effects: Effects are defined as an array of objects:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)effect$(): Potion effect ID$(li)$(thing)duration$(): Duration in ticks$(li)$(thing)amplifier$(): Effect level (0 = I)$(li)$(thing)ambient$(): Show subtle particles$(li)$(thing)show_particles$(): Show effect particles$(li)$(thing)show_icon$(): Show HUD icon
hotbath.entry.custom_json.translations: Include a $(thing)translations$() object in your JSON:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)en_us$(), $(thing)zh_cn$(), etc.: Fluid name$(li)$(thing)en_us.desc$(), $(thing)zh_cn.desc$(), etc.: Description$(br2)HotBath automatically reads these translations when loading the fluid - no resource pack needed!
hotbath.entry.custom_example.name: Examples
hotbath.entry.custom_example.page1: Hot Bath includes an example data pack with $(thing)7 custom fluids$(). Check the $(thing)hotbath_example_fluids$() folder in the mod's data pack directory to see how they work!
hotbath.entry.custom_example.golden: A luxurious gold-colored bath that provides $(thing)Regeneration II$() and $(thing)Absorption II$(). Uses warm gold color, triggers after 10s. Perfect for royalty!
hotbath.entry.custom_example.slime.title: Slime Bath
hotbath.entry.custom_example.slime: A bouncy slime-green bath that provides $(thing)Jump Boost III$() and $(thing)Slow Falling$(). Has higher viscosity for that slimy feel!
hotbath.entry.custom_example.blazing: An extremely hot bath (80°C!) using blaze powder. Provides $(thing)Fire Resistance$() and $(thing)Strength II$(). Luminosity 12 for a glowing effect. Don't worry, you won't burn!
hotbath.entry.custom_example.ender.title: Ender Bath
hotbath.entry.custom_example.ender: A mysterious cool bath (15°C) using ender pearls. Grants $(thing)Invisibility$() and $(thing)Speed III$(). Low viscosity for that otherworldly feel. Triggers after just 12 seconds.
hotbath.entry.custom_example.enchanted: A mystical lapis-blue bath that brings fortune. Provides $(thing)Luck II$() and $(thing)Night Vision$(). Luminosity 8 creates magical ambiance. Great before dungeon runs!
hotbath.entry.custom_example.milk_tea: A warm, comforting milk tea bath with $(thing)opacity$() setting for creamy look. Provides $(thing)Saturation$() and $(thing)Speed$(). Also has $(thing)nutrition: 4$() - you can drink it!
hotbath.entry.custom_example.silent: A mysterious hot spring with NO particles, bubbles, or steam. Provides $(thing)Invisibility$() and $(thing)Night Vision$(). Demonstrates how to disable all visual effects for a serene experience.
